description: This file contains Drupal hook implementations for the menu_ui module, including help text, entity type build modifications, block alterations, access control, form alterations for nodes and node types, entity deletion handling, breadcrumb modifications, theme hook definitions, and entity operation customizations related to menus and menu links.

classes.name: MenuUiHooks
classes.description: Class implementing Drupal hooks for menu UI functionalities, including help, entity type build, block view alteration, access control, form modifications, deletion handling, breadcrumb alteration, theme hook, and entity operation.

methods.name: help
methods.description: Provides help text for the menu_ui module, including documentation links and instructions for managing and displaying menus.

methods.name: entityTypeBuild
methods.description: Modifies entity types to set form and list builder classes for 'menu' and adds constraints to 'node' entity type.

methods.name: blockViewSystemMenuBlockAlter
methods.description: Alters the block view for 'system_menu_block' to add contextual links based on the menu name.

methods.name: getMenuLinkContentAccess
methods.description: Checks access permissions for menu link content, allowing update/delete if entity exists, or creation if not.

methods.name: formNodeFormAlter
methods.description: Alters node forms to add menu link fields, including parent selection, title, description, weight, and visibility based on permissions.

methods.name: formNodeTypeFormAlter
methods.description: Adds menu options to node type configuration forms, allowing administrators to specify available menus and default parent links.

methods.name: menuDelete
methods.description: Handles cleanup when a menu entity is deleted, removing references from content types' third-party settings.

methods.name: systemBreadcrumbAlter
methods.description: Modifies breadcrumbs to include links to the menu when editing menu links.

methods.name: theme
methods.description: Defines theme hook implementations, specifically for menu link forms.

methods.name: entityOperation
methods.description: Provides custom operations for menu blocks, such as 'Edit menu' if the user has access.
